reason: CH37-S01 introduces the EWRA concept and its purpose; CH37-S02 later applies that foundation by defining inherent risk as the starting point of most risk assessments.
review_reason: EWRA concept and purpose directly ground the inherent risk starting point.

reason: CH37-S01 establishes the EWRA framework and its focus areas; CH37-S02 later applies that framework to the process of determining inherent risk and prioritization.
review_reason: EWRA framework directly grounds the inherent risk determination process.

reason: CH37-S02 defines inherent risk; CH37-S03 later applies that concept in the residual risk formula (inherent risk - control effectiveness = residual risk).
review_reason: Inherent risk is a required input to the residual risk formula.

reason: CH37-S02 introduces control strategies and the internal control framework; CH37-S03 later expands on design effectiveness of controls.
review_reason: Control strategy and framework context directly ground design effectiveness.

reason: CH37-S02 introduces control strategies and the internal control framework; CH37-S03 later expands on operational effectiveness of controls.
review_reason: Control strategy and framework context directly ground operational effectiveness.

reason: CH37-S02 introduces the concept of assessing control effectiveness; CH37-S03 later explains the importance of measuring control effectiveness.
review_reason: Assessing control effectiveness directly grounds the later explanation of why measurement matters.

reason: CH37-S03 introduces the residual risk formula; CH37-S04 later applies it to compute residual risk and assess tolerance.
review_reason: The residual risk formula directly grounds residual risk calculation and tolerance assessment.

reason: CH37-S02 describes the process of determining inherent risk and using scoring mechanisms; CH37-S05 later applies that foundation to risk assessment tools and scoring methodology.
review_reason: Inherent risk scoring process directly grounds later risk assessment tools and scoring methodology.
